title: Type Brief — Campaign intake; spawns Deliverables (Asana/Workfront)
description:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. Publicist accepted.

## Type: Brief

Attached to a Campaign. Asana/Workfront-style **intake**. The Brief is what agents and humans steer from; it **spawns Deliverables** (`kind` enum, one production workflow).

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **campaign** (required)
- **goal / audience / offer** (hire conversation)
- **track**: `hire` | `human`
- **deliverable checklist** to spawn: LandingPage, Video (optional), ImageSet, SocialCopy, PpcCopy
- brand kit, legal, LP SLA, UTM = fields on Brief/Deliverable, not types

## Out of scope

- Not a Marketo Program
- Not a Deliverable
- No implementation from this issue
